- **`transport/FrameCodec.java`**: `encodeEvents(List<Event>)` → host→guest batch (`HOST_TO_GUEST=0x0001` flag); `TEXT_CHANGED` writes text as a length-prefixed string into the batch string section and references it by relative offset in `op.b`; `VALUE_CHANGED` packs `Float.floatToRawIntBits(value)` in `op.b`; pointer events pack x/y in `op.b`/`op.c`. `decodeEvents(byte[])` decodes exactly `TEXT_CHANGED`, `VALUE_CHANGED`, and `POINTER_DOWN/MOVE/UP` — **it does not decode KEY_DOWN/KEY_UP**, and ignores non-EVENT opcodes.
- Batch format: magic `PLPL` (0x504C_504C), `VERSION=1`, header 16 bytes, `GUEST_TO_HOST=0x0000`, `HOST_TO_GUEST=0x0001`.

Host-side routing: the demo `SessionApp` classes (`pathland-quarkus-demo/.../SessionApp.java`, `pathland-spring-boot-demo/.../SessionApp.java`) call `FrameCodec.decodeEvents(message)` and dispatch into the `RenderResult` maps (`tapActions` on pointer-up, `textInputs` on `TEXT_CHANGED`, `valueInputs` on `VALUE_CHANGED`).

FFM/native ring path: `ffm/PathlandCore.java` binds `pathland_core_drain_events` and `pathland_core_send_event` for host→guest EVENT opcodes on the desktop shared ring.

**Absent**: any FOCUS, EDITING, SUBMIT, SCROLL, WHEEL, or key-event end-to-end support (no listener bits, no view wiring, not decoded). `KEY_DOWN`/`KEY_UP` exist only as `Commands.Event`/`Commands.Listeners` constants; `KEY_REPEAT` only as a flag constant. No `pointer_events` method; no `TapRecognizer` class in this module (AGENTS.md references an app-side `TapRecognizer`, but it is not in `pathland-view`).
